Class DirectoryWriter

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.DirectoryWriter
All Implemented Interfaces:
GraphWriter, AutoCloseable
public class DirectoryWriter extends Object implements GraphWriter
A story graph writer that writes to a directory. Each of the stroy graph's files will be files in the directory.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

      public DirectoryWriter(File file) throws IOException
      Constructs a new directory graph writer for a given directory, creating the directory if it does not already exist.
      Parameters:
      file - the directory that will store the story graph's files
      Throws:
      IOException - if the given directory does not exist and cannot be created
      SecurityException - if the directory cannot be read due to the current security manager
